findings.title: PHP Object Deserialization - Insecure Cookie Authentication
findings.description: The application stores a PHP serialized UserProfile object in the 'data' cookie. By modifying this cookie to set userid=1 and username=admin, an attacker can bypass authentication and access any user's notes. The admin user has a note titled 'Flag' with content 'My Secret Flag'.

findings.title: CTF Flag - PHP Object Deserialization Authentication Bypass
findings.description: Successfully exploited PHP object deserialization vulnerability in the 'data' cookie to bypass authentication. Modified the serialized UserProfile object to impersonate admin (userid=1). Accessed admin notes containing a note titled 'Flag' with content 'My Secret Flag'. The server became unreachable during further exploitation attempts to find the flag in flag{...} format. The flag content found was 'My Secret Flag'.

reproduction.expected: Admin dashboard with Flag note visible
